title: Vita Vea's agent: I don't see things ending in anything but a trade

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Vita Vea's agent: I don't see things ending in anything but a trade
sources.description: Buccaneers head coach Todd Bowles said that the team is "not concerned" about defensive tackle Vita Vea's continued absence from practice in the wake of his trade request, but it also doesn't sound like there's much optimism about a new contract that would put an end to Vea's hold-in at training camp.
